entries.text: Not every day we get to see h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer round the\nacademy, huh?[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]For sure! We’re not in the same grade as
[VAR 0x0100(0000)],
either,
so
it’s
lucky
we
bumped
into h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_kakutou_01

entries.text: You doin’ all right, pal? Not sure what to make of\nthat dumbfounded look you got goin’ on there.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_03

entries.text: Who might you be?
entries.label: s2_sub_007_select_01

entries.text: I feel like I know you...
entries.label: s2_sub_007_select_02

entries.text: Oh, that’s right! I forgot we’re not wearing our\nusual outfits today...[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_kakutou_02

entries.text:
Man, now that you mention it, I guess this is the
first time [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she’s seeing us lookin’ all proper in our
academy uniforms, huh?\c
Yeesh. Now I feel all awkward about it...[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_04

entries.text: But hey, let’s clear things up. It’s me—Giacomo!\nOr DJ Vice when you catch me at the deck![VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_05

entries.text: Eri here! But I’m sure that was obvious.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_kakutou_03

entries.text: We came in today to take some makeup tests.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_06

entries.text: Figured it was about time we started clawin’ back\nall that learnin’ we missed out on while we were\r\nholed up in our bases.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_07

entries.text: Our Team Star outfits aren’t all that practical\nfor tests and things, so we came in our new\r\nschool uniforms today.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_kakutou_04

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hey, Eri... You think [VAR 0x0100(0000)]
could
help
us
out
with
our
ongoing sitch?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_08

entries.text: Hey, that’s right! Great idea, Giacomo![VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_kakutou_05

entries.text: What’re you both thinking?
entries.label: s2_sub_007_select_03

entries.text: Can I help with something?
entries.label: s2_sub_007_select_04

entries.text: We’ve got a little proposal for ya...[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_09

entries.text: How’d you like to be a tutor?![VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_10

entries.text: Geez, one step at a time! Maybe we should start\nby explaining what’s going on?[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_kakutou_06

entries.text: Whoops. Right you are, Eri.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_11

entries.text: So, ah, OK. Basically, the other Team Star bosses\nare havin’ a rough time of it...[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_12

entries.text: You remember Mellie, Ortie, and Atticus, right?[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_kakutou_07

entries.text: Those three, yup. They’ve been takin’ makeup\ntests like us, but they sure ain’t passing ’em...[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_13

entries.text: They might actually have to repeat the year,\nwhich would suck after all the effort they put in\r\nto come back to school.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_14

entries.text: Before you ask—me an’ Eri have already tried\ntutoring them ourselves...[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_15

entries.text: But it didn’t go well. At all.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_kakutou_08

entries.text:
Nope. You know, I seriously didn’t think those
three’d have such a hard time.\c
I mean, for me, it feels like all you need to do to
pass tests is learn formulas and memorize stuff.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_16

entries.text: Guess I just can’t wrap my head around what it is\nthey can’t wrap their heads around...[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_17

entries.text: And I’m only good at teaching people if it’s to\ndo with sports or exercise...[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_kakutou_09

entries.text: We heard from Penny that your grades are\npretty decent.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_18

entries.text: I bet even Ortega and the others would perk\ntheir ears up if you dropped by to teach ’em![VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_19

entries.text: Which loops us right back to my opening refrain.\nThink you could help tutor for us?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_22

entries.text: Yeah, I’d be happy to help!
entries.label: s2_sub_007_select_05

entries.text: I dunno if I’d be good at it...
entries.label: s2_sub_007_select_06

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Thanks so much, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
You
really
are
the best![VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_kakutou_10

entries.text: No, you’ll be GREAT at it. I just know you’re the\none for the job, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_kakutou_11

entries.text: Whoops—almost forgot! We gotta keep this\nunder wraps, OK? No telling Penny![VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_20

entries.text: We’ve stressed her out enough for one lifetime—\nthere’s no way we can bother her with this![VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_aku_21

entries.text: This’ll be our little secret, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_kakutou_12

entries.text: We’ll be right here, so come let us know when\nyou’re ready to start![VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_007_kakutou_13
